oracle-l5r-10340.note: Chiyurei's Axe (Item, issue #732): its Equip discount ("Attaches to Hida Chiyurei paying 2 less Gold") is a P2 entry term and +3F is printed, but its second sentence, "Melee Attacks this Personality performs may be compared against the target's base Force", is a trait of the performer on every Melee Attack he performs. The comparison itself is built (AttackCompare.PrintedForce) but an Attack's optional comparison is a static function of the ability id (AttackCompareOptions in EmperorRulingR5.cs, read by ValidateAbility's Choice gate, the offered-ability loop's compareChoices and its label in CardAbilities.cs, and AttackComparedValue), so a performer-scoped option needs those four places to learn the performer. A shared-interface change in the central action builder, not a card-wave line; the card is not published, so no printed effect is dropped (docs/decisions/2026-10-06-690-p24-effect-primitives.md, limits).

oracle-l5r-10370.note: Duty Over All Things (Strategy, issue #732): the scan reads "Battle: Choose your performing discarded Yojimbo: If he would be opposed, bring him into play at the current battlefield, paying 3 less Gold if you control a Courtier or Shugenja." The performer of the action is a Yojimbo in the owner's discard pile, and the action recruits that same card into play at the battlefield. The engine has no support for a Dead or discarded Personality as an action's performer (AbilitySourceZoneAllows and the performer lists read cards in play; P21's province-source and zone pieces do not cover a discard-pile performer), and "if he would be opposed" asks whether an enemy unit stands at the battlefield the card would enter. Needs a performer-from-discard rule and a recruit of the performer by an action, with a ruling on when "would be opposed" is judged.
